name: Lidian F1
summary: Lidian F1 is Li-Gong’s wheeled humanoid robot, built with two articulated arms and a folding waist above a mobile base. The manufacturer describes autonomous navigation, voice and gesture interaction, and coordinated handling for factories, laboratories, retail and commercial service sites. The selected image and embodiment refer specifically to the F1 documented in Li-Gong’s June 2025 product brochure. Current delivery availability has not been verified.
